Animal Rescue India is leading wild / Domestic  animal rescue organization in Maharashtra, based in NASHIK. our team always strives to help all the injured , sick, abused animals in distress. we have been working for wildlife conservation sines 10 years .

Please share our videos to support wild & street animal rescue and to help spreading awareness.

and SUBSCRIBE our channel to see beautiful animal rescue videos.

Contact: animalrescueindiaorg@gmail.com

Instagram: https://instagram.com/eco_echo_foundation?igshid=1hybdsygb45i0

Facebook: Eco Echo
